    def resolve(m):
        ours, theirs = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if name == 'README.md':
            checker = theirs[theirs.index('The regression-result checker'):]
            return ours.replace('\nRun offline reporter tests with:', '\n' + checker + '\nRun offline reporter tests with:')

        return '''    // The team bootstrap pins the reviewed checkout to an exact commit.
    def ref = validateRef('trusted CI ref', env.CI_TRUSTED_CI_COMMIT?.trim()

        sh '\''\''\''#!/bin/bash

            mkdir -p .ci-report-source

            git -C .ci-report-source show FETCH_HEAD:ci/jenkins/github_report.py > _trusted_github_report.py

'''
